correctness.rationale: For any real SPD arrowhead, diagonal congruence yields a 3D active energy form with squared coupling masses s,t; orthogonal leaf directions are annihilated. Symbolically calculated generalized characteristic polynomial \(\lambda[\lambda^2-(R+st)\lambda+st]\), eigenvalues \(0,0,R\), identity \(P^3=RP^2\), and rank-one squared norm \(R^3+(1-R)^2st\) give exact all-horizon formulas. Signs of derivatives prove both sharp optimizers for every admissible subset. An explicit 3-vertex family proves arbitrarily large regret at two sweeps. The included verifier recomputes key identities and 7000 direct matrix cases. Finite checks supplement, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The natural worst-case energy norm for a complete exact-coordinate sweep is a useful finite-work convergence diagnostic. On a nontrivial arbitrary-size SPD star it yields exact, opposing optimal permutations for a single versus any later sweep even though all spectral radii coincide. Weighted subset partition governs order selection, and a 3-vertex family shows the mismatch can cause unbounded two-sweep relative regret. The result is structurally motivated and independent of a paper-sized downstream application.
